verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments platform, so payout scheduling and payout reconciliation are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence pack only covers transfers, bulk transfers, subaccount payment splitting and collection methods. Nothing documents controlling the settlement or payout schedule, or a per-payout breakdown of charges, fees and refunds.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout
